name: square_dance
text: Dancing a lively step-touch: take a big sideways step left and tap the right foot beside it, then take a big sideways step right and tap the left foot beside it. Repeat these side-to-side dance steps continuously. With each side step, swing both arms outward away from the body at waist level. Bounce the knees to the rhythm.

review.notes_zh: 左右小侧步、屈膝换重心和摆胯组成的单人广场舞片段；双手主要在腰侧，未形成大幅展开。仅交单人动作，无多人同步编排。
